verdict: The product moments are believable and every state I could reach is designed: live 'Could cut' marks, put-back with keyboard and enlarged hit areas, stale-result dimming, empty, over-limit, test-input, undo, an honest preview sheet with focus trap, focus return and inline email errors, zero console errors, 9.96 screens at 390 and 10.39 at 360. It sits just under 9.5 because the Try box, the page's one real product, under-delivers on two of the most common lines its first audience will paste, and a handful of small interaction surprises remain.
to_95: Make the on-device demo land on the two cliches a crypto/X writer pastes first: a stacked hedge ('I think that maybe $SOL is probably going to break out soon, not financial advice' currently cuts only 'that') and the thread announcer ('In this thread I will explain 7 reasons why most traders lose money' currently returns 'Kept as written' with no button). Either cut them, or when the quick check declines, show a primary action instead of a text-only dead end.
Give the 'Kept as written' result the same button row as the other results (it is the only outcome with no CTA under the card).
Make the hero ghostwriter button say what it does ('See Marco's review link' with a down arrow) instead of 'Send to Marco', since it scrolls about 3,900px to Studio.
Soften the split marker in the hero draft so '98k|and' does not read as a stray caret with a missing space in the first glance.

issues.where: #sharpen Try box and final input (on-device engine output)
issues.problem: Two archetypal lines for the stated first audience get weak results. 'I think that maybe $SOL is probably going to break out soon, not financial advice' -> 'Cut 1 bit of fluff', only 'that' removed, with 'I think', 'maybe', 'probably' all left ('Kept $SOL and your "maybe"'). 'In this thread I will explain 7 reasons why most traders lose money (and how to fix it)' -> 'Kept as written', phrase marked but not cut ('without it the line says something else'), while the page's own Newsletter example cuts the equivalent 'In this issue I wanted to talk about'. A visitor's first paste is the conversion moment; these read as the tool not seeing obvious fluff.
issues.fix: Treat 'In this thread/post I will explain|show|share' + number/noun as a cuttable announcer like the newsletter case (-> '7 reasons most traders lose money (and how to fix it)'). For stacked hedges (2+ of I think/maybe/probably/kind of in one clause) cut down to one and say so in Why ('Three hedges became one. Kept your "maybe".'). If the engine must decline, see uiux-2.

issues.problem: This is the only result state with no button under the card (the keep row is empty); the next step is an inline text link inside the Why paragraph. 'Nothing to cut' gets 'Schedule it free', cuts get 'Keep it. Start free'.
issues.fix: Show a button in the keep row for this state: 'Get a rewrite free' (opens the sheet with the rewrite intent and the visitor's line), and shorten the Why copy to the reason only.

issues.where: Hero window, Ghostwriter example, foot button 'Send to Marco'
issues.problem: The label promises an action on the post but the click smooth-scrolls roughly 3,900px to Studio and moves focus to 'Approve'. The other three examples' 'Schedule' opens the sheet. Same position, different kind of outcome, and no cue that it is a jump.
issues.fix: Relabel to 'See Marco's review link' with the down-arrow icon used on the 'Try this draft' cue, or make it open the sheet with the Studio plan preselected like the other examples.

issues.where: Hero draft and 'Trades, launches, newsletters' rows: split marker before 'and'
issues.problem: The 1.5px bar before the dimmed 'and' ('at 98k|and', 'this month|and it's') reads at first glance as a stray text caret with a collapsed space rather than 'split here'. It is in the hero's first product moment.
issues.fix: Keep the bar but give it clear space either side (about .3em), shorten it to cap height, and fade it to about 35% once the animation settles; or replace the settled state with the same ember underline treatment at lower weight so all removed words share one visual language.

issues.problem: With an over-limit paste the editor scrolls internally and the first visible row is clipped at the card's top edge with no fade, so it looks cut off rather than scrollable.
issues.fix: Add a 12px top mask (mask-image linear-gradient) on the editor when scrollTop > 0, or let the card grow to about 8 rows before scrolling.

issues.where: 390 header; 'Try it' row buttons; 'See it again'; Replay icons
issues.problem: At 390 the header has no route to Pricing or FAQ (links are hidden, no menu), so the only path is scrolling about 7 screens or the footer. Several secondary controls are 24-32px tall ('Try it' 59x24, 'See it again' 111x28, reply Replay 32x32) with no enlarged hit area, unlike the struck words which have one.
issues.fix: Add 'Pricing' as a text link beside 'Sign in' at 390 (it fits once 'Start free' hides on scroll, and at the top there is room at 13px), and give .wtry, #pf-go and the replay buttons the same ::after hit-area expansion to 44px that .tog already uses.
